reason: This plugin is classified as a navigation-panel tool because the repository describes a DSH web client extension that builds a turn-grouped conversation outline from markdown headings, tracks reading position for auto-highlighting, and enables smooth in-page jumps via a dockable UI panel.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面的导航插件，会将会话中的 Markdown 标题提取为回合分组的大纲面板，支持自动高亮与点击跳转。
summaries.en: This is a navigation plugin for the DeepSeek Harness conversation UI that extracts markdown headings into a turn-grouped outline panel with auto-highlighting and click-to-jump behavior.

capabilities: Extract Markdown headings (H1–H6) from conversation messages
Render a navigable outline panel for in-conversation headings
Auto-highlight active outline entries during scrolling
Jump smoothly to selected headings in the conversation view
Support panel docking/resize behavior with persisted UI state
